dkar chagadapal ldan bde srung las khungs nas rtsal ba'i ched brjod/par skrun gsal bshad/ gcigartsom sgrig pa'i gleng brjod/ lnga/le tshan dang po / dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba 1le tshan gnyis pa/ bod kyi rtsa don 'khur du blangs pa/ 14le tshan gasdokyim pa/ nam rgyun las dzawa tshod gcig gi snga ba'i mkhar rnga/ 21le tshan bzhi pa/ grwapo dang dmag mi gnyis dngos su gdang thug byung ba/ 30le tshan lnga pa/ nga cho 'a chad 'u thug skabs bsang tshong bu mo 'chi med kyis bag leb bskyal ba/ 377

le tshan drug pa/ rgu tsha btson khang du bcug pa/ 49le tshan bdun pa/ nga tsho dargon nas phud pa dang /lhag bsam rgyal ma35na khro sems gce na ma thub pa/ tsa 64le tshan brgyad pa/ zhing khul du bsdad pa dang /ma so/ngas pa'i bsams gzhigs/ 72le tshan daspya pa/ btson byol ba'i lam dang /7gang sa mchag mjal ba/ 83le tshan bcu pa/ dbyangs can sgrol dkar dang /bza' hrūr glur pa/ 87le tshan brtsug pa/ lo rabs brgyad cu nas btsan rgol rgyal skyob kyi las 'asdo/la nang ༷kyigs po'i rang gi spun nye khag cig gi la rgyus mdar bsdus/ 89le tshan brtsus pa/ sku gshegs 'thab bo gas gnyis la dran gso sdokyi/ 10351

zur ban la/ rgya ma rin chen sgang sangs rgyas khru dbon gyi rnam thar gtso bor byas pa'i yul gyi byung ba rags rim tsam dang / 'bum pa nyams gasdud zhus pa'i gnas tshul mdor bsdus/ sni 107hor khang bso/da nams dpal 'bar/51

dpar skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling go la'i steng 'bur du don pa'i bod kha ba gangs can gyi ljongs 'di nyid spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo brgya phrag du ma nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung / yul goms bakhres lugs/ sa cha'i gnas babs sogs sgo gang sa nas rang btsan gtsang ma'i rgyal khab cig yin pa bsnyon med rtsod bral yin yang rgya nag gong ma rim byon skabs bod rgya gnyis mchod yon gyi 'brel lam de brgyud bod 'di ches snga mo zhig nas rgya 'og tu 'khyur mid gtong sems kyai re ngan thabs brgya jus stong byas yad rung / dngos su spyi lo 1949 nas 'go btsugs gyis mthar 1959 lor rgya nag dmar gzhung nas zhi bde lhing 'jags su gnas pa'i bod chos ldan gyi zhing khams yangs su drag po'i btsan 'dzul gyis gtor bcom 'phrog gsum gyi sgo nas bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus nang byung myong med pa'i khrab/ gi 'khor la bskor/ bod mi rnams gzhis byes gnyis su gyes te dus 5

dpar bskrun gsal bshad/ gnyis/de nas bzung bde skyed kyi 'tsho bar rol rgyu lta ci/ 'jig rten 'dir dmyal ba mun nag gi sdug bsngal tshad las 'das pa myangs dgos byung ba red/rgya dmar gyis bod nang thog mar btsan 'dzul byed skabs bod la rogs ram bya rgyu'i kha g.yang bsgrags kyang don dngos thog lo ngo stong phrag mang po'i ring gsog 'jogs byas pa'i bod kyi chos shes dpal gsum dang / yul goms gshis lugs/ rang byung skye dngos rtsi shing / gter rigs khag ming gi lhag mar btang ba ma zad/ bod mi 'bum bcu gsum la nye ba dus min rkyen 'das su btang ba dang shul lhag bod mi tshor rig gnas gsar brje zer ba sogs ming sna tshogs btags nas btson bcug dang do dam/ 'thab rtsod dang slob gso sogs kyais nyin 'khyol yang mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i dka' sdug gi lo zla de dus deng sang yang myong bzhin yad /⑩spyi nor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas gsum cu'i dus dran thengs 28 thog bstsal ba'i bka' slob nang / de snga so so rang nyid kyi thog la gnas tshul mang po zhig byung ba dang / de bzhin gzhan zer rjes 'brangs ma yin pa'i khungs ldan gyi gnas tshul rang gis mthong thos byung ba dag tshang mas do snang chen pos yig thog tu 'god dgos/ de 'dra ma byas na/ gnas tshul snu

gsum/ dpar bskrun gsal bshad/sdug bsngal ji snyed rang thog myangs pa'i mi mang po zhig rim bzhin rdzogs 'gro yi yad/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus skabs shig la de'i tshe de'i dus sdug po zhe po zhig byung ba red ces spom tshig tsam ma gtogs gcig nas gnyis su brgyud pa'i gnas tshul zhib tshags su la'ang bshad rgyu med pa chags rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug der brten dngos byung lo rgyus rgyas bsdus gang yin yang yig thog la bkod de yig cha mang tsam 'don thabs byed dgos/ zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don dang / lhag par btsan byol spyi tshogs nang tshogs sde dang mi sger gang rung nas deb rigs sna tshogs par skrun byas dang byed bzhin yod na yang las gzhi 'di'i thog dmigs bkar phyag las gnang mkhan med khar/ rang yul bod nang gzhi rtsa'i smra bajiod rang dbang tsam yang med na mi tshe'i lo rgyus ngag rgyun tsam las yig thog 'god rgyu shin tu dka' bas skyid sdug mi 'dra ba rgyud pa'i mi tshe'i dngos byung gi lo rgyus de dag dang thog rang gi skad yig thog gsog sgrub bgyis te 'di nas bod dbyin gnyis thog rim pas dpar 'grems byed thub na/ lo rgyus deb phreng kha thor du mi 'gro bar rjes rab klog pa po rnams la 'tshol bde dang / de bzhin mgon po gang nyid kyi dgongs gzhi rlabs po che sgrub thub pa ma zad/ bod kyi chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus rtsom sgrig dpar skrun gyi stong cha bskang thub pa sogs la dmigs 51

dpar bskyun gsal bshad/ bzhi/te 'di ga tshogs pas ngal ba 'khur blangs kyis las gzhi 'di 'go 'dzugs bgyis te da bar chab srid btson pa'i la rgyus deb phreng bco lnga dpar skrun zin pa dang /da dung par skrun zhu 'char mang dag cig yod khongs nas da res chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus deb phreng bcu drug pa 'di bzhin ngag dbang stobs bcu'i la rgyus (nying 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/pa/ces pa dngos su spyan 'bul zhu thub pa 'dis rgyal spyi'i steng bod don thog rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dang / de bzhin bod nang si yid skyo ba'i gnas stangs la nyams zhib banang mkhan rnams la lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhir thugs phan sos re/ lhag par bod phyi nang du gnas pa'i rang rigs gzhon skyes rnams la bod nang gi gzhon skyes tshos bod rgyal khab dang mi rigs ched dka' ba gang 'dra spyad pa gsal rtogs kyis mes po'i khrag rgyun ded nas bod bstan srid rang dbang slar gso'i don du zungs khrag gsar pa zhig sbyin thub pa'i re ba byed bzhin yod/ da lan deb phreng bcu drug pa 'dir rang gzhung bde srung las khungs nas ched brjod bka' drin bstsal ba dang / lhag par lo rgyus kyi bdag po dang rtsom sgrig pa/ 'di ga'i las byed yongs nas phyar gru mnyam 'degs gnang ba'i 'bras bus mthar par skrun zin par bcos min snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/511
sna/ dpar bskyun gsal bayad/bod gyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshogs pa'itshogs gtso/ka tsha ngag dbang 'od 'bar nas/spyi la 20kya7 zla 7 tshes 13 nyin/snu111

rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brjod/lting 'jags med pa'i tshe stod ces pa'i deb 'di klog rjes zhi bde lcing 'jags ngang gnas pa'i rab byung ba rnams masnur skyom nas nya snu mi bde ba bzos pa ltar/ rgya gzhung gis ched du gnas bzod mi bde ba bzos pa'i 'char snang zhig ngang gis 'ongs/ nga rang rgis nye rabs bod don 'thab rtsod/ pa'i lo rgyus la rgyus lon byed skabs dang bod kyi dka' ngal mang ro zhig mthong skabs/ de sngon nas 'char snang 'di 'dra zhig byung ba ni/ bod kyi gdan sa chen po bzhis gtsos chos sde khag nang gzhung chen por thos bsam byas te/ ma 'ongs sangs rgyas bstan par byas rjes 'jog nges pa'i mi sna skyed sring 'ong skabs/ rgya gzhung gis ched du chab srid kyi rlung 'tshub re bslangs te sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzhi mi tshugs par bzo ba ma zad/ lo rabs brgyad bcu nas bzung lo rabs lnga bcu dang drug cu'i skabs bzhin dmar gsod chen mo'i don 5sto

bdun/ rtsom sgrig pa'i smeng brjod/rkyen med kyang / grwa gzhon du ma'i mi che'i las dbang stong zad btang yod/gnad don des deng skabs kyang bod kyi chos sde khag nang 'chad nyan rkang btsugs thub pa nyung zhing / spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / yang sgos bod kyi shes rig thog khyodang gun gsab thabs bral ba zhig red/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa ni/ lung gi chos sde smod gsum la 'chad nyan dang / the gas pa'i bstan pa bslab pa gsum nyams su len pa de yin pas/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rgyun spel byed dbang yod na chos dad rang sna/sa yod par 'jog pa las/ phyag 'tshal skor bsags dang bsang bdug lda gsol byed dbang yod pa tsam gyis chos dad rang dbang yod par cha 'jog ci la byed/deng skabs bod kyi chos sde khag gi las dbang gi kha lo yul skor spro 'cham pa 'gro yul 'grems ston khang dang grwa pa rnams dam pa'i chos/ kyi dri mas ma 'gos pa'i dmar ser bo/sa kyis bklubs pa'i rgyas spros bag med can gyi sku drag tu sgyur 'ing yod pas/ rgya gzhung gi bod kyi chos sde khag la 'dzin pa'i dmigs yul mthar thug 'dir bod mgo nag rtsam zan yongs dang / lhag par bod kyi skyes sprul du rloms pa che rgu 'bring zhan mtha' dag gis nges par 5sto

btang snyoms su 'jog mi rigs so/gong smos kyi gnad don de ni ngag dbang stobs bcu lags kyi lo rgyus kyi snying don thog nas gsal por 'khod yod pas nga tshos kyang sngar dran deng bsdur gyis bod kyi rang dbang slar gso'i ched phugs rgyang ring zhing dkyel che ba'i bsam tshul bzung ste/ las don gyi kha khyodags bsgyur thabs byed dgos/mjug 'dir/ lo rgyus kyi deb 'di'i thog ma'i ma zin 'god skabs rogs phan mdzad mkhan ngag dbang 'phrin las lags dang / 'di ga'i 〉rgags gretso ka tsha ngag dbang codad 'bar lags kyis mtha' ma'i spyan zhib bskyangs par thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ blo bzang bkra shis kyis/spyi lo 2007 zla 8 tshes 24 nyin/5myo
lgi e 'i tshes+hong 'jags da pa da/55

dang rngos/dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba /nga chung dus rmo bo yis nyin rtag tu dkon mchodag gi rten gyi drung du lus ha cang gi dul ba'i rnam pa dang mig zung cung btsum tsam ngang lag gnyis snying khar thal mo sbyar nas phyi ma mi lus len pa dang dam pa'i chos dang mjal bar shog ces/ smon lam 'debs tshul de gtan/ nas brjed thabs mi 'dugapha gtam bu 'jags sam mi rabs nas lta spyod de 'dra zhig 'khyer ba'i nga tsho'i grong gseb nas dpal ldan dang / bkra shis bag bro sogs snga phyir gdan sa chen po dga' ldan dgon du rab tu byung / spyi lo 1985 'otsware bkra shis pa'i nyin zhig la khong tshos 7kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa dga' ldan dgon du chibs sgyur gnang gi yod pa'i gtam bzang zhig nga tsho'i grong gseb tu 'khyer yong bas/

na lbing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/khong phebs tshes gtan khel shes kyi med kyang yul mi rnams brel 'tshub chen pos 7dga' ldan dgon pa'i phyogs su gzab mchor dang bcas te rim pas chas/ de 'dra'i nus pa che zhing khyab myur ba'i gtam der phran rang ya mtshan skyes/ phran bsam shes thub tsam nas nga chorware bo nga gseb tu 'du 'dzoms du ma byed myong yang mi rnams kyis shub bur mi 'dod pa'i lab lab 'don pa las de 'dra'i spro snang zhig mthong ma myong /nga'i pha karma dge legs dang a zhang blo gros kyis nga'i re 'dod bzhin zhogs pa thod rengs nas phran pha'i mdun lnga sa bzhon rtar bskyon nas dga' ldan dgon du chas kyin/ 7kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po ches bod kyi bstan srid mi rigs ched sku srog la ltos med mdzad 'phrin bskyangs tshul rnams gleng /dga' ldan gyi ri sked bsam blo sgang la slebs dus nyi ma 'char la nye ba dang / dbang skur ri'i phyogs dang nyag rong lha kha nas 'brog pa 'ga' zhig rkang thang dang / kha cig rta/ 'ga' zhig g.yag la bzhon nas yong ba dang / 'brog ri'i sgang gi lam brgyud rta 'then 'khor lo dang / bung bu/ rta/ rkang thang bcas mdor na/ ri ldebs thams cad mi dang bzhon pas khyab cing dga' ldan dgon par phyos/sa te bskyod/lag ya gcig gi mdun ngos lta bu'i spang ri chen po der me tog rnams 2

dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba 3kyis kun nas khyab pa ni/ tshem drub sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa'i sngo ljang lha gos sa gzhir g.yogs dang mtshungs shing / shing tsha ru dang spa ma/'khan pa sogs kyis khyab pa'i lag gi mthe bong 'dra ba'i nags ri'i steng bya byi'u 'jol mo'i gsung skad lhang lhang thos/gong mdzub dang mthe bong gnyis kyi bar lta bu'i ri nyag mtshams su sha ba la khar thon pa lta bu'i gyang ros khengs pa'i dbus dmar lheb tsam gsal ba'i gtsug lag khang der/ zhang pos yangs pa can gtsug lag khang dang / de'i steng dang g.yas g.yon bcas kyi gyang ldebs su skya thigs bsgron pa lta bu'i khang pa bzhi yod pa rnams klu 'bum khang tshan dang tre hor khang tshan/ nyag re khang tshan/ mnga' ris khang tshan bcas red ces ngo sprod byas/nga tsho tree hor khang tshan du lung pa gcig pa/ dpal ldan/ bkra rshas bag gro/ tshe ring bcas kyi shag tu sna ga khres bzhag ste dgon pa'i khrom sgang du 'gro skabs/ dgon pa'i ri sked bsam blosgang dang / yangs pa can gyi gtsug lag khang thog kha nas chodas bo sa ngur smrig gas ra pas klubs pa'i dge 'dun pas phyag tu mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa dang /rang lugs kyi chas gos dwangs gtsang gyon pa'i dad ldan ser skya mi mang rgan byis bar gsum gyis lag tu lhad med kyi mjal dar dang / dri 3

4 nying 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/bzang gi bdug pa bzung zhing / dgon pa'i khrom sgang nas shar rtse grwa tshang dang / zung chu khang tshan gyi rgyab/ klu 'bum khang tshan bcas brgyud bang bzhi sgrig yangs pa can gtsug lag khang bar mthud nas thams cad kyis mig la gsham la 17gas shing gnas/dri bsang bdug pa'i dud sprin gyis 'brog ri dga' ldan gyi khor yug yongs su sprin dkar lang long du 'phyur ba dang yongs su mtshungs la/ shar phyogs kyi la rtser 'phags pa'i nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'od kyis de bas kyang khor yug de dag las mtshar snang shin tu che bar snang / la gsham gyi lam chen brgyud rlangs 'khor chung ba 'ga' gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis 'ong bzhin 'dug par/ mi mang rnams kyis mig zung stong phrag du ma rlangs 'khor la phyogs shing lag thal mo sbyar nas ngag nas smon lam shub bur 'don 'go tshugs/bsam blo sgang du yud tsam phebs ḍol bkag tsam gnang / de ni sngar rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis phebs bsu zhu yul sngar srol zhig red ces zer/ rlangs 'khor chung ngu lnga tsam gyi rjes rlangs 'khor zhig gi steng du mjal dar grangs med dpyang yod pa dang / da dung mi mang rnams kyis thag ring nas mjal dar kha ba'i 'dab ma lalhab lhub tu 4

dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba/ 5g.yo ba ltar 'bul bzhin pas/ phebs ḍol de ni gangs dkar gyi gong bu zhig ga ler bgrod 'ong ba dang mtshungs/dung chen dang / rgya gling / sbub chal bcas kyi sgras dben gnas de'i khor yug yongs su dkrogs pa dang / khrom sgang du phebs ḍol las sku la na bza' gos chen ser po 'brug ris can zhig bzhes pa'i mi pho rdzig nyams can zhig thon pa dge 'dun pa gnyis kyis spyan rgyas sdun bsus pa'i tshe/ nga rang byis pa'i skabs a mas gsungs pa'i lha sras mi yul du phebs pa'i skor de yid la lhang nger dran/mi rnams kyis gsol ba smon lam 'debs pa dang / 'gas smre ngag grangs med 'don zhing gnas pa rang gi sems su 7kun gzigs rin po che yin par nges pa rnyed de/ zhal mjal ma thag lus la dad pa'i spu long g.yo/ phran dang ha cang thag nye'i khrom sgang nas mgon po mchog gis dgon pa'i gling du zhal phyogs nas thugs ha cang pham pa'i rnam pas/ sku phyag thengs gsum btsal grub rjes zhal nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i gdan sar nyam chags 'di 'dra zhig byung ba gang yin nam/ de sngon rje rin po che'i sku gdung hril po de da cha sku rus tshal bu gcig las lhag med/ ngas khong gi sku rus la phyag 'tshal gyi yod/ces gsungs/5

nam rgyun las chu tshod gcig bi snga ba'i mkhrar rnga/ 23las khyed tsho shes rgya dang thos rgya che zhing / lag len dngos kyi thog 'jon pa yod/ 'on kyang nga la mkhan wa'i ming zhig yod/ ces gsungs/bod mi bkra bzang gis spyi 'e/ 1996 zla 5 tshes 6nyin mo 'di ni rgya nag dbus gzhung krung dbyang nas bka' phebs pa ltar/bod rang skyong ljongs mnga' khongs kyi dgon pa che shos gdan sa bzhis gtso bor gyur ba'i gzhis dgon yod do cog la/ chab srid kyi cadab gso'i las don brtsams 'go tshugs pa dang / de ring dga' ldan dgon par chab srid slob gso'i las 'gul sgrog sbyang byed kyi yin pas yag po nyan dgos/ nyin 'di nas bzung / dgon pa'i gling du tā la'i dpar sgrig mi chog twa las mi rigs mthun sgril la gtor bshig dang / mes rgyal la rgyab gtod/ phyi rgyal khag tu tshogs pa sna cesags btsugs nas rgyal khab la ngo log brgyab ste/ nga tshor phan las gnod pa che ba byas yod/ der brten dgon pa'i nang gi twa la'i par de tsho mar phobs shigagal srid lag star ma byas tshe phyis drag sku nga / zhes da dung mu mthud skad cha shod rtsis byed par nga tsho tshang ma kho pa'i ham shed kyi glo bur ba'i skad cha der hon 'thor te/ ngar sems skyes nas ma gros bsam mthun gyis tshang mas sdebs langs brgyab nas mgrin gcig tu/ khyed tsho'i stad cha der nga tshos nyan 'jog gtan nas byed kyi min/ gnas tshul 23

24 lbing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/de tsam ma zad nga tsho'i bod 'di rang btsan gtsang ma red/ ces brjod de 'u thug gi mchongs sam/ 'jigs zhum med pa'i lan 'debs byas/grwa gzhon 'gas mi mngon par rgya las la rde'u chung ngu re rdeg pas rgya las rnams shin tu skrag nas lnga mchod khang gi thog kha dang / rgyud khang phyogs su bros ma stabs kyis phyin/ mkhan po dang / dbu mdzad/dge skos/ mkhan sprul rnams ci bya gtan nas med par tab tab por rang shag tu logang tsho grwa gzhon rnams der lam seng tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs te bgro gleng byas pa brgyud / 7gong sa mchog gi sku dpar sgrig gshom mi chog/ ces pa ham pa tsha drag pas/ da lta'i chab srid kyi las 'gul der mtha' gcig tu ngo rgol bya rgyu thag bcad de/ lha sa'i chos don las khungs kyi mi rnams la gnas tshul gses bkrol byed par lnga mchod khang gi gzim chung du phyin yang / kho pa tsho dang las don ru khag rnams bros pa'i shul/ gzim chung gi g.yas g.yon la a rag shel dam brtsigs pa dang / gang byung du dor ba'i tha mag gi ro/ thod kyi gyang gi steng rgya mi'i rgyal dar zhig bkal sku da pa bcas mthong ba tsam gyis khong khro dang skyo snang shugs che skye ba'i bod mi'i sems khams dang goms gshis la mthong chung khyad gsod snang med dang / lhag par chos 24

nam rgyun las chu tshod gcig gi snga ba'i mkhar rnga/ 25phyogs nas dam drag shugs cher byed pa'i gnad don la ltos med de ltar byas pas/ dge 'dun pa rnams de bas ngar langs/nga tsho grwa pa rnams kyis kho pa tsho nyin de ring dgon nas phud thub pa bya rgyu'i mna' skyel dam bca' bzhag cing / grwa gzhon brgyad cu tsam gyis lam seng khrom sgang du phyin nas gzhung lam bkag par bskyod pa dang / de byings rnams rgyud khang du rgya gzhung gis btsugs pa'i don gcod khang du bskyod nas sgo ra'i nang 'dzoms skabs/ kho pa tsho thog sa nyis thog gi rdo skas steng rkub stegs byas nas snang med tshul du bsdad 'dug grwa mang gis chos dad rang mos yin pas rtsa ba'i bla ma 7gong sa mchog gi sku par bzhag mi chodag pa ga re yin nam/ bod rang btsan dgos/ 'ga' shas kyis bod mi rtsam pa za mkhan thon sna/ga zer ba dang /'gas khyed tsho ngo mi tsha'am/ bod pas bod par gnya' gnon dang mi rigs kyi zhabs 'dren byed kyi yod dam/ zhes sogs gcig 'gyur min/ pa'i skad 'bod sna tshogs chu tshod phyed tsam byas/blo bzang gis gtsos las don ru khag gi mi snas tā la'i bla ma'i par bzhag mi chog pa krung dbyang gis bka' yin pas/ khyed tsho 'jon po yod na krung dbyang la lobs/ nga tshor khag gang yang med/ ma gzhi khyed tsho bsam blo yag po thongs/ mdzub mos gnam 'bigs mi thub/25

2snyo wīng 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/ces sogs bshad/ phan tshun gzhi mthun pa'i gnas med rkyen grwa mang rnams ngar sems lhag tu skyes shing phran dang spo lod/ lhag pa gsum gyis ru drangs te rdo skas 'dzegs nas las wa na ru khag gi mdun thog sa nyis thog la skad 'bod sna tshogs dang / skor ba gsum brgyab/mchod mjal zhu ba'i skya ser dang / shar byang gnyis bzhengs mkhan lag shes pa dang ar po ba rnams re re bzhin grwa mang dang mnyam 'dzoms nas skad 'bod nang zhugs/ rgyud khang gi nang du gshongs thabs med par phyi nas kyang skya ser rnams kyis skad 'bod sna tshogs byed kyi 'dugaskor ba gsum 'khor rjes rgyab nas las don ru mi'i phyogs su rdo chung g.yugs pa dang / de nas rdo che ru che ru btang ste g.yugs yong bas/ las don ru mi rnams nang du bros te sgo stems kyang blo bzang kho pa gcig pu gdengs spobs chen wa'i tshul gyis snang med ma bros par bsdad/ grwa mang rnams kyis rgyud khang gi thog kha'i khang pa'i rdo g.yam spus legs rnams bkog ste/ sgo la rdzog rdo bzhus nas sgo dang sge'u khung cha tshang bcag cing kho tshor nyes rdung tshad med btang ba dang / phyi rol du yod pa'i blo bzang 'ju bzung gis rdeg gin phar tshur 'then nas/ kas/ bod rang btsan gtsang ma red dam/ rgyal ba rin po che 26

nam rgyun las chu tshod gcig gi snga ba'i mkhar rnga/ 27la dad pa yod dam med/ ces sogs dris pas/ klo bzang gis bod rang btsan gtsang ma red/ rgyal dbang rin po cher dad pa yod/ sku mkhyen tshe thar gtong rogs gnang / zhes sogs kha nas lab rdol sna tshogs 'byin/grwa gzhon rnams kyi ngar sems zhi ma thub par las don ru mir mu mthud nyes rdung tshad med gtong ba'i skabs/ dgon pa'i las sne dmangs gtso bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang gi 'go byed rgan blo bzang bsam gtan dang / dngul gnyer tshe brtan bcas 'byor te las don ru mi rnams 'chi na/ dgon par gyodang gun chen po phog rgyu yin pa smos med thog de bas nyen chen po zhig chags srid/ sku mkhyen las 'gul mtshams 'jog rogs zhes zhu ba grangs med 'then pa dang / las don ru mi rnams gdong par khrag ral 'dzar rer lus ha cang 'gul bskyod dka' bar gyur yod kyang / pus mo sa la btsugs shing lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas sku mkhyen/ thugs rjes gzigs te srog skyob rogs gnang / da res las 'gul de krung dbyang kyi bka' btang ba ma gtogs nga tshos rkang btsugs nas byas pa min/ bod rang btsan yin pa ma zad nga tshos ga dus kyang 7gong sa mchog la dad gus dang / yid ches sku da/nga tsho bod rig/sa gcig pa red/ ces sogs zhu ba grangs med 'then 27

na8 lcing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/pas rgyud khang gi steng shod gnyis khengs yod pa'i las 'gul ba rnams re re bzhin rang gnas su phyir 'then/dgong dro'i chu tshod gsum dang phyed kar phran shag nas yang bskyar rgyud khang du phyin te lta skabs/ las byed bzhi po gog bgrod ngang gling slor lam kha'i 'og tu yib kyin bros/ da dung dpe cha ba lnga tsam dang / lho ba phrug brgya lhag tsam gyis las don ru mi blo bzang gi mtha' skor nas kho pa'i kha par dang / mdzub mo sa steng bzhag nas the sa btsabs pa sku gas ma 'chi tsam zhig bzos shing / nang du yod pa'i spyi bde mi sna'i chas dang / zhwa mo rnams dbral ba dang / nang chas rnams phyir g.yugs te kho pa de gar bzhagadagong dro'i chu tshod bzhi par nga tsho sngar rgyun ltar dpe khrid la bcar skabs nga tsho'i 'thab bo gas 'gas/ las don ru mi dang dgon par mchodad cing bsnyen bkur ba'i sbyin bdag nor nas sbyin bdag gi rlangs 'khor la rdzog rdo zhus pa dang / sbyin bdag rdung rdeg btang ba'i nor 'khrul gyi las tshab chen bsags pa shes byung /dus tshod de'i ring la dbu mdzad dang / grwa chos rgyal/ byang chub sku gas kyis 'chi la nye ba'i blo bzang gsang ba'i thog the bo chodas ra'i zur du 'jog skabs/ blo bzang gis sku mkhyen nga mnga' ris khang tshan 28

nam rgyun las chu cho da gcig gi snga ba'i mkhar rnga/ 29gyi mkhan wa'i shag tu skyol dang / zhes smras pa/ khong tshos kyang mkhan gro'i shag tu bskyal zhing mkhan po blo bzang rgya mchosas kho pa'i kha nang du byin rlabs blugs pa dang / gong zhus tshos gsang ba'i thog blo bzang btegs te la babs nas gtsang tog sman khang du bskyal yang / blo bzang si lag pa dang rtsibs ma bcag yod pas gtsang tog sman khang bis 'gan len ma thub par lha sa'i sman khang zhig tu bskyal/sman khang du dgon pa'i 'go khrid kha cig blo bzang la sems gsor 'gro skabs/ kho pas las don ru mir sdod ring dgon par gang ci'i thad la sems 'khur dang sha tsha chen po byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang grwa pas de las ldog ste/ drin can gyi lag pa rdos rdung / zhes pa'i dpe ltar las don ru mi gzhan las nga la sdang zug chen pos nyes rdung tshad med btang byung / zhes blo pham tshad med kyis mig chu phrum phrum gtong gi 'dug zer/ dbu mdzad dang dge skos kyis gsang ba'i thog rgya las khyod bzang sman khang du bskyal bar grwa mang gis mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur lha na skabs/ khong gnyis kyis dgon pa spyir gyong gun mi yong ba'i ched du yin pa las/ kho tsho'i bkod jus la nyan pa dang / khong tshor dga' drag nas min stor 'grel brjod mthar phyin mdzad pas snga gas gzhi bsal nas phyogs gnyis dam gtsang byung /29

badzee pa/grwa pa dang dmag sgi dngos su gdong thug cung me/dgong zas tshar rjes rlung bu bsil bu zhig gis bskul ba'i rgya phibs kyi zur du dpyang pa'i dril bu rnams kyi sgra lhang lhang rna rtsar sim pa dang / chabs cig nga'i sems nang rang bzhin gyis skyo snang zhig 'char/ de don grogs po 'ga' la bshad pas khong tsho'i sems nang yang rang bzhin gyis bag mi phebs pa'i tshor snang zhig skyes sgor brjod/nam rgyun bzhin mkhar rnga'i sgra de ni chu tshod drug par tag tag lnga mchod khang gi thog kha nas grags pas/ rim pas dge 'dun pa rnams chos rar 'gyor te dang por zhal 'don dang / de nas rtsod sgra dang pheg brdab pa'i sgras 'brog ri yongs su khengs shing gnas mur/srod kyi mtshams la sped nas slog 'od khra chil ler spar ba'i rlangs 'khor grangs med ru sgrig gis yong ba/ chos rtsod la rol bzhin pa'i 30

grwa pa dang dmag mi dasbyos su gdong thug byung ba/ 31dpe cha ba lnga brgyas mthong ma thag sning chung ba rnams dpa' khum nas dngas skrag gis lus 'dar zhing / ngag kyang dab dib bab col smra ba dang / 'bring ba rnams bzhin gyi mdog 'gyur yang nga tsho mu mthud chos rtsod la rol nas ya lan ma byas par gnas na/ nyes skyon med shas che zer/ spro thung ba rnams ni tsha ge tshig ger gdong len la 'gro dgos zhes sngon du shor rtsis byed/ dpa' che 'ing blo rīng ba rnams kyis nga tsho sngon du gros shig byas nas thag gcod do/ zhes phra da kyin spam tshugs bstan/mthar gros mthun la ma mthun zhig shod na/ra rgya dmag gi rlangs 'khor rnams dgon pa'i rlangs 'khor 'babs tshugs khrom sgang la 'byor nye bas/ grwa pa rnams rang shag tu myur bar phyin nas lag tu dbyug pa dang / tshal ta'o/ gri/ lcags hreng / sham bu'i 'ur rdo/khye/ ma/ 'jor/ rdo sogs 'khyer nas rgya dmag rgi gdong len du kha cig gling stod nyag rong lha kha'i sgang 'og dang / 'ga' zhig gling smad nyag ra mnga' ris gnyis kyi rlangs 'khor gyi lam 'gog par bskyod/phran gling stod du yod cing dgong mo'i chu tshod dgu pa tsam la nga tsho nyag rong lha dga'i gyang ro dang / zu po/ brag gi gseb rgya dmag la sgug ra sprad de lta stabs/ rlangs 'khor gcig gi nang deng dus 3/

32 lbing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/kyi go mtshon me mda' dang / glog rgyug phubs/ lcags zhwa sogs thogs pa'i dmag mi bzhi bcu zhe lnga yod pa grangs brtsis thub kyang /rlangs 'khor ga tshod yod min ma mthong / rlangs 'khor las babs pa'i dmag mi rnams tshang 'dzoms thog go mtshon lag tu bzung nas ru sgrig btang ste/ mdun bskyod byed kyin nam mkhar me mda' grangs med 'phen zhing / nyag rong lha dgar nga tsho dang gom pa bcu tsam gyi rgyang khyad du 'byor ba dang / nga tshos dus gcig la rdzog rdo 'phangs te rgya dmag gi ru sgrig gtor te/ rgya dmag rnams khrom sgang bar rdo ded btang /nga tshos mar thal bskyod ma byas par nyag rong lha dga' phyogs la yar yong nas btsan sa bzung rtsis la/ rgya dmag dpon zhig gis mchongs/ zhes brda sprod pa dang / lam seng dmag dung btang nas rgya dmag rnams 'ur yang /nga byis pa'i skabs thengs du mar mthong myong ba'i glog brnyan rnams gnas stangs de 'drar yang phra lham mer dran/ dpa' ngar che zhing / dka' thub dang 'chi rgyur mi skrag pa/ drang bden dang nyam thag gi mgon skyabs krung go gung khran tang ni / dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dpung gis go min tang log spuod shog khag dang / btsan 'dzul ba ri 32

grwa pa dang dmag mi dngos su gdong thug byung ba/ 33pin 'dre dmag la dpa' ngar chen pos dmar 'dzing byas kyang g.yo sgyu che ba'i dgra bo las thengs gcig gam gnyis pham rjes/ nga tsho byis pa rnams blo pham che zhing / byis pa 'ga' sems skyod nas mig chu phrum phrum 'don gyi yod/mthar blo gros dang 'thab rtsal phyug cing brjid nyams ldan pa'i bcings 'grol dmag mi'i dpon zhig gis mchongs zhes brnga/ sprad pa dang / chabs cig dmag dung btang nas lcags las grub pa'i gung khran tang gi dmag mis shog bu dang / 'jim brnyan lta bu'i dgra dmag rnams yud tsam la rtsa med gtong skabs sems nang ha cang dga' spro skyes kyi yod/da cha ni nga tsho'i mgon skyabs dmag dpung gis nga tshor go mtshon thad kar gtad de sha 'od rdol ba ltar 'ur yong skabs/ grwa pa rnams ngar sems lhag tu skyes nas tshang mas mchongs zhes ngar skad 'don bzhin/ rgya dmag gi mdun bsus nas rdo bcom btang ste dgra bo'i ru sgrig phyed tsam gtor zhing / yun cig ring rgya dmag rnams rngo char 'og phyir bshig shor/nga tsho mun khrod bsdad yod pas slog 'od las rgya dmag rnams kyi 'gul bskyod gsal bar mthong zhing / rgya dmag rnams kyis gnam 33

na4 lhing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/mda' dang / dngos su nga tshor sdig ste 'phangs pa'i me mda'i mde'u rna ba'i mdun sing sgra dang bcas te rgyug pa dang / me mdel 'phog pa'i pha bong gi ldel phye dang me stag tsag sgra dang bcas te thor yong yang nga tshos zhum pa med par mun khrod nas rdo ded btang rkyen nga tsho las ldab 'gyur gyi mang ba'i rgya dmag rnams mu mthud phyir bshig shor/gang mtshams shig nas dran rgyu rgod paci( rgya dmag gis/ rlangs 'kho ra gyi glog dang / lcags khrab 'khyer ba'i dmag mi'i glog bzhu chen po bcas dus cig tu nga tshor bkye ste/ me mda' grangs med 'phen pas/da gin gyi cha rkyen las go cadag nas rgya dmag gis nga tsho tshur nyin gyi dus ltar gsal gsal thing thing mthong ba dang / nga tshos gzi shugs che ba'i glog 'od brgya phrag las rgya dmag gcig kyang mi mthong / dang dzad rgya dmag dang 'thab 'khrug byed dus mtshan de 'khyol tsam yong gi red snyam yang / rgya dmag gis glog 'od bed spyad pa des nga tsho yun tsam las mi brtan pa gtan khel bas/ nga tshos gyang ro'i gseb nas yud tsam 'ojab rdo 'phangs te me mda'i kha gtad gcog gin/ srog 'go gang than bras/nga rang bros kyin gyang gseng nas bltas pas rgya dmag lnga brgya tsam nyag rong lha dgar 'byor nas/ me mda' 'phog ste rmas pa'i lo 34

grwa pa dang dmag mi dngos su gdong thug byung ba/ 35nyer gnyis la son pa'i mal gro skyid rgu rdo rje dang / lo bcu gsum tsam la son pa'i stag rtse ser khang gi dbe legs st+rin pa bros skabs/ pha ngo nga zhig nas mchongs pas 'gril nas bros ma thub par lus rkyen/ rgya dmag bi/sa bzung / khong gnyis la rgya dmag gis lcags thag brgyab ste rlangs 'khor la btags shing / rlangs 'khor gzhan zhig gi glog 'od khong gnyis kyi gdong la brgyab ste rgyang grags nas bod rgya'i skad thog 'bar kog tshang ma 'jon po yod na mar thon shog gsad rgyu yin/ da ga re byed rgyu yod dam/ zhes 'bod pa'i sgras dgon pa'i gling yongs su khengs/slog 'od 'og tu bzung mi gnyis la nyes rdung tshabs chen gtong gin grwa mang la snying rlung slong yang / nga tshor byed thabs ma byung bar rang shag sku sor log pa yin/ shag tu 'byor skabs chu tshod bcu gcig tsam red/ rang gio lus la lta stabs sham thab la me mda'i mde'us bug ga gsum btan 'dugagal srid do nub rgya dmag gis drag gnon bya tshe/ nga tshor khong pho dang 'dra ba'i go mtshon yod na gtug chog kyang me mda'i ming tsam yang med/ bstan dgra'i mdun du pham 'khur nas sdod dgos/ dang bstan pa'i don du bstan dgrar 'dzing nas srog blos gtong dgos sam/35

36 lhing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/gnas stangs 'di lta bur nga tsho rab tu byung bas ci byed dgos snyam ste the tshom gyi mur/ glo bur 7gong sa mchog dran te sku par mdun langs nas gsol ba btab cing / 7gong sa mchog gi byin rlabs bzas nas gsod rdung ci byed kyang thabs shig mi 'dug snyam ste nyal yang / gnyid rtsa ba nas ma khug pas chu tshod gnyis pa tsam la yar langs te/ lcags thab nang shing gi me kha zhig gsos shing ja bsgol nas btung ste nyal yang gnyid ma khugs/gcin pa gtong bar 'gro skabs me mda' dang glog bzhu 'khyer ba'i dmag mi bco lnga tsam gser gdung gi thog kha dang / khri thog khang /byams khang bcas kyi thog tu yod pa dang / rang shag gi thog kha'i star par dmag mi lnga tsam zhig 'dug dgon pa'i khrom sgang rlangs 'khor 'bab tshugs kyi za khang de yang dmag mis bdag bzung byas/36

/4 lhing 'angags med pa'i tshe stod/sogs/ khyon zla ba dgu'i ring mnar gcod tshad med myangs mthar btson chad lo dus bcu bzhi'i khrims thag bcad pa red/rgu tsha'i bsgu na khang ni/ rgya nag rgyal khab kyi khrims dang 'gal ba'i chab srid btson pa dang nyes gsog btson pa rnams bkag nyar byed yul spyi mtshungs shig yin yang / dmigs bsal chab srid bathergan par sdang zug che ba byed pa dang / gong nas zas gron ji tsam sprod min ma shes kyang ma byan du nyes gsog btson pa bskos pa dang / zas bsri tshags bya thub na/ nyes gsog pa'i lo tshad chag yang gtong gi yod pas ma byan rnams kyis rang nyid kyi khe phan ched/ zas la gron chung bsri tshags byas te btson pa spyi sku ngas la zas kyis grod pa rgyag gi med/gtsang sbra'i thad kyang thengs shig tshal nang btsog pa ser thing nger yod pa dngos su mig mthong byung / btson pa dang nang mi thug 'phrado kyi nyin gus la thug 'phrad yang mkhan dang / rngan pa gang yang ma 'byar bas/drin pha mas kyang thugs rje rgyang du btang ba min nam snyam yang rjes su a ma lags zla re'i thug 'phrad la chad med 'byor yang gus dang thug 'phrad byed ma bcug khar/ zas nor rnams 'phrog pa shes byung /res gza' pa sangs nyin gyi nga tsho'i sgo srung ba nyi ma'i g.yog por nga tsho'i nyal khang gcig pa nyes gsog pa mig dmar che ba dang sgo 54

rku tsha btson khang du bcug pa/ 55rtags bco brgyad nang yod pa'i chab srid btson pa a mdo 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims gnyis 'bod kyi yod/ go skabs de brgyud 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims kyi bza' zla mal gro ba ngag dbang dbyangs can gyis sgo srung ba nyi ma brgyud/ 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims la zas sne sel re 'byor ba nas nga phor cha bgos byed kyi yod pas skabs der phan thogs ha cang chen po byung / 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims sgo srung pa'i g.yog por bskyod kyi yod stabs/ phyi nang chab srid kyi gsang ba'i gnas tshul gang sku da shod kyi yod/spyi 24 1996 zla 5 tshes 6 nyin gyi las 'gul nang zhugs pa'i dga' ldan gyi grwa pa 'dzin bzung du 'tshud pa nas phran la skul slong byed mkhan dang / phun tshogs dbang 'dus kyi// gsang ba'i tshogs pa'i tshogs mi yin pa/ de sngon phran dang rgyag lod kyis dgon pa'i 'du khang dang / the po chos rwa/ shar byang gi grwa tshang g.yas g.yon bcas la bod kyi rgyal dar dang / yig cha sbyar ba mi khag cig gis cung rdzi rig ste gsang brda sprad yod pas/ de dag gi nyes pa 'gel thabs dang / 'bri gung klung shod spu lod la rdo 'phen mkhan gyi bkod jus byas pa'i nyes ming dang / bag sku la las 'gul gyi sne khrid kyi dogs gzhi sogs byas te nga tsho gsum la mnar gcod shugs che shos btang / kho pa tshos 'jigs 55

5snyo lnging 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/ snang ji tsam bskul yang btson du ma 'tshud tsam nas skul slong legs por bcos sku da pa ma zad/ btson du yang bod bstan pa chab srid kyi don yin snyam ste/ gasnga nga len ma thub pa rtsa ba nas ma byung / nga tshos thengs dang por bshad pa'i skad cha las 'gyur ba ma btang stabs khrims thag ma bcad par yun ring 'gor pa red/stabs ma legs pa zhig la blo bzang dpal ldan la dri rtsad byed dus ngo rgol gyen langs skabs/ spu lod kyi lag tu rdo bzung yod sgor khong gis brjod 'dug pas/ des rkyen byas te spo lod la nyes rdung tshad med gtong gin 'dri rtsad thengs mang byas rung da dung yang khong gis ngos len ma byas/ mtha' mar khong la dus bkag btson bcug lo 15khrims thag bcad/ rgya ma bag gro yang nyes rdung mnar gathe da tshad las 'das pa btang ste dri rtsad byas rkyen/ mthar na zug ma bzod par khas len byed dgos byung stabs dus bkag btson bcug lo 15 khrims thag bcad de/ da lta yang grwa bzhi btson khang du yod/phran gyis sems su khong gnyis la lo tshad mtho shos bzos sku/da pas/ gus kyis khas len ma byas par mkhreg bzung byas stabs stabs der btson pa kha gcig spo bo spra rmog tu gtang rgyu'i gleng phyogs sku da pas/phal cher spo bo spra rmog btson du 'gro rgyu red snyam pa bzhin grogs po 56

rgu tsha btson khang du bcug pa/ 57'ga' la yang de don bshad/ bsgu na grogs dga' grwa bkras chos dang bag gros khyed rang mgo mkhregs po ma byed/ btson khang du lo kha shas las sdod dgos kyi ma red/ mu mthud mkhregs po byas tshe spun mched sogs thug rgyu med par spo bo spra rmog tu 'bo dbo sa na/ yag po mi yong / zhes sogs dzā ba gso gnang yang / gus pa'i sems nang lnga sa len zhu rgyu'i bsam blo rtsa ba nas ma 'khor/bkras chos la lo gsum gyi khrims thag bcad de khri zam batho na khang du gtong khar khong gis phran la khyed rang spra rmog tu gtong nyen ha cang che zhes/ phor pa dang / rtsam pa/ dor ma gcig 'o rtsam bcas gus par gnang ste/ ma 'ongs nga tsho thug min shod khag kyang / nga lo gsum rjes gson por gnas na khyed rang gtug par spo bo spra rmog tu yong rgyu mna' skyel dam bcas yod/ spra mor nga tsho'i dgon pa'i rgan bstan pa dbang grags dang / rgya dar gnyis yod pas/ nga tsho'i gnas tshul rnams bshad tshe khong gnyis kyang dgyes mnyes dang / khyed la yang rogs pa byed srid/ ces sems gasku grangs med mdzad rjes rgya mis 'khrid/ de bzhin nga tsho'i star pa dang po dang / gnyis pa nas dga' ldan gyi grwa pa du mar lo tshad bzos te grwa bzhi dang khri zam gnyis la khag bgos byas/57

snyo0 lhing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/nga tsho'i btson khang gi nyes don nyes gsog pa bod pa gnyis dang rgya mi gnyis lo tshad btson 'jug bzos nas grwa bzhir bskyal ba dang /rgya mi gcig srog thog btang ste mthar batho na khang der phran gcig pur lus/ nyin shas nas rgya mi rkun po gsum mnyam du bcug ste/ zas za skabs rgya mi tshos kha phor gyis snod nas zas gcus pa phran rang nyid grwa pa zhig yin stabs/ rang gzhan kun gyis rgyun nas gtsang sbra chen po byed kyi yod pa dang / bod pa'i lugs srol la yang de ltar min pas/rgya skad ma shes kyang rnam 'gyur dang lag pas de ltar mi rung ba'i brda sprad rung / nyan 'jog gang yang byed kyi med stabs ngas rgya rigs 'ig gi 'gram par 'gram lcag cig bzhus rkyen/ rgya rigs gsum pos mnyam rub thog shugs gang yod kyis gus pa 'og tu mnan pa dang / rdog pas rdeg pa/ ske btsir ba sogs kyis nyes rdung btang bas/ ngas kho tsho gsum la kha gtad bcag rgyu'i nus pa bral stabs/ skad shugs chen pos btson srung ba 'bod pas btson srung ba rgya mi krang lacod phang slebs te nga tsho bzhi por nyes rdung tshad med gtong skabs/ rgya mi gsum pos krang la'o phang la skad cha mang po zhig bshad pas/ kho pas gus par slog rgyug btsugs pa sogs ro/na med dmigs bsal gyis nyes rdung tshabs chen btang /60

rgu tsha btson khang du bcug pa/ 61kho pa tsho'i byed tshul der ngas kyang ya lan zhig sgrod dgos snyam nas btson khang gi sgo srung bod pa dbang grags dang / li phang gnyis sdod bya'i skabs ngas rgya mi gsum por rdeg ste kho tshos nga gsod pa 'dug ces skad kyang brgyab/ sgo srung ba gnyis po yong ste nga la skad cha dris byungo ba gus pas rgya mi gsum khrodas ngo dus rgyun nas chab lta ga balha bar gtang ba dang / kha sang 'khrug pa shar skabs rub rdung sprad pa ma zad/btson srung ba krang la'o phang gis kyang gus gcig pur lho ga rgyug btsugs pa sogs kyi nyes rdung btang tshul gsal por brjod/sgo srung ba gnyis pos rgya mi gsum wa ra spyodag rgyug btsugs pa sogs rdung rdeg gnad smin btang ste/ da nas bzung khyed tsho gwasum pos kho la dbang yod shod pa dang / rdung rdeg btang tshe de bas las sla por mi 'jog ces bshad pas/ dus de nas bzung nga la dbang shed ma byas kyang nga tsho mnyam du sdod ring dka' ngal snon pa zhig 'phrad pa ni/ rgya mi gsum lnga/sa mtshan mo mal gdan gyi sring bal bshedan nas shog bur bsgril te tha mag gi tshul du 'then pas/ tha mag gi dri ma ngan pa des nga la ha cang dka' ngal 'phrad rkyen/ nyin zhig gtsang sbra'i tshogs 'du'i skabs gus pa nyal khang gzhan zhig tu gnas chad chodag pa'i re ba bshad kyang don thog ma 'khyo' /61

62 lhing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/nyin shas rjes rgya mi gsum dang gus pa tag se zhig rtsed rgyu'i go skabs byung / de nas bzung nga tsho phan tshun 'cham mthun du gyur te phan tshun bsam shes gang mtshams byed thub pa byung yang de ni yun ha cang thung ba zhig ste/ mi ring bar rgya mi gcig bye rag nang srog thog btang ba dang gnyis rgya nag tu btson khang gnas spo byas/ nga'i nyal khang du slar yang rgya mi nag tshong rgyag mkhan gsum dang / rgya gar la bros byol 'gro skabs lam bar 'ju bzung byas pa'i stod lung pa thub bstan zhes pa zhig kyang bcug byung / nyin zhig bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par thog bod du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi chab srid slob gso'i las 'gul spel te/ dga' ldan dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa tshos rgyal gces chos gces dang / twa la'i ru tshogs la rgyab gtod/ twa la'i par cha tshang dge 'dun pa tshos rang mos kyis mar phab pa red/de'i thog nas dga' ldan dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams ni rgyal gces chos gces pa zhig yin pa bstan pa red/ ces bsngags brjod dang /chabs cig 'dra par zhig kyang bkod/kha dang rna'i bar gyi rdzun gtam la nga rang ha las shing hon 'thor/ don der ngo rgol gyen langs byas pas nga tsho dga' ldan gyi grwa drug cu re gsum rgu tshar btson 'jug byas yod pa rnams kyi mdun 62

da wa rgutshabatsonakhang du bcug pa/ 63mngon sum la snyon pa'i rdzun gtam spel nas/ khrag dang rngul chu bton pa'i bden don de dkrog gtam tshig gcig gis rmeg med bcom sa thabs byas pa red/ mi rnams kyis bde don la gces su 'dzin pa bzhin bden don ni nam yang bden pa'i ngo bo las mi 'gyur ba zhig yin pas rim pas rgya dmar gyi rdzing rkub brdol ba red/63

6snyo lbing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/lhag par gtam bshad kyi mjug tu mi ngan 'di dag lam seng rang gi shag chas 'khyer te skyes khungs su log dgos/ zhes brjod ma thag dge 'dun pa rnams yar 'ur gyis bzhengs pa dang / de dkyil nas 'phan sngo/ ba lhag bsam rgyal mtshan gyis skad shugs chen pos kho tsho dgon par rang 'jags 'jog dgos/ 7gong sa mchog sku tshe khri lor brtan par shog nga tshos nam yang 7gong sa mchog la mtshan smad dang bkur 'debs zhu 'dod med/ ces sogs skad 'bod byed kyin mdun du mchongs/ de rjes dge 'dun pa yongs kyis mgrin gcig tu bod rang btsan yin/ 7gong sa mchog sku tshe khri lor brtan par shog ces sogs kyi zhi rgol 'os langs byas pas/ de ma thag rgya dmag gis lhag bsam rgyal mtshan dang / stag rtse thar rgyas tshul khrims/'phan po spen pa bcas gsum 'jus nas sa gnas de rang du nyes rdung tshabs chen btang ste/ btson skyel rlangs 'khor nang khrid/ de rjes nyes rdung dang / me mda' gang byung du 'phen pa sogs kyis dge 'dun pa rnams bya thabs med par rgya dmag gis kho ma sgang du bkar/ nga tsho ni snga sa nas rgya dmag re res lag nas bzung yod stapas byed thabs ci yang ma byung bar ca dngos len par grwa shag tu khrid/66

nga cho dgon nas phud pa dang / lhag bsam rgyal mtshan khro sems gnon ma thub pa/ 67phran la dpe cha dang / grwa chas/ lto snod bcas las med kyang tshang ma sdeb gcig tu 'khyer thabs bral bas dpe cha gcig pu 'khyer te/ yang bskyar khrom sgang brgyud skabs 'thab grogs 'ga' mgo bor skra sor lnga tsam skyes shing sgal par rdog mkhres chung ngu re 'khyer te /dmag mi gnyis re'i rgyab 'ded dang bcas dgon nas kha bral nas 'gro ba dang / gzhogs gzhan zhig la dge 'dun byings rnams phyug rdzis dud 'botsware khyu tshogs lhas rar bkar ba bzhin dmag mis mtha' bskor te gnas 'dug pa dang / nga tsho'i rjes de ma thag de nyin las 'gul nang zhugs rkyen tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyis lam seng phud pa'i nga/ge 'dun pa brgyad cu lhag tsam zhig khungs so sor bskyal rgyu'i rlangs 'khro/ ra nang khrid yong ste/ grwa pa dang rgyab 'ded dmag mi dang bcas pa'i rlangs 'khor bsdoms nyi shu tsam gtsang tog brgyud 'gro skabs de khul gyi yul mi tshang mas lam kha'i g.yas g.yon dang khang lnga ga bcas nas lta bzhin mig chu gtong /rgya las kyis mal gro gung dkar rdzong 'bring rim mi dmangs khrims khang du tho 'god dang / sa yig bris dgos skor bshad kyang nga tsho su gcig gis kyang sa yig ma brgyab stabs/ kho tsho bya thabs med par slar yang rdzong de'i khyab khongs 'bri gung dang / rgya ma/ thang skya/67

68 lngionga'ajagasamed pa'i tshe stodo/mal gra gung dkar khag sa sar gang zhus rlangs 'khar rnams khag bgos thog mal gro gung dkar snyu nga gi las byed kha cig gis mnyam du skyel rogs yong ste/ gus dang / tshe dbang dbang 'dus/ slo bzang dpal ldan/ blo bzang dge 'dun/ 'jam dpal ye shes/ bsodacinams rdo rje/ bstan chos/ blo bzang mkhas grub bcas nga tsho mi bdun rgya ma shang du rtsis sprod skabs shang gi 'go 'khrid nas tho bkod pa dang /shang krang gis gus tshor khyed tsho khyim pa las shes 'jon che rung / da res khyim pa las kyang sdug pa'i nor 'khrul bsags pa red/ slad rang khyim du nang mir chab srid kyi skul slong dang / phyi rgyal du yod pa'i spun nyer yig/ 'brel/ zhing las kho na ma gtogs las rigs gzhan la 'dzul zhugs/ zhabs rim/ phyi dro glog brnyan lta ba sogs byas mi chog phyir bskyod dgos tshe gang byung du 'gro mi chog par rdzong nas ngo sprod yig ge len dgos/ lung par chab srid kyi sbyar yig sogs kyi don rkyen lhag tshe khyed tsho 'dzin bzung bya rgyu dang / de'i 'gan 'khri pha ma tsho la yang yod/ ces sogs btson khang nas spyodad 'grol zin yang 'gro sdod dang / smra brjod rang dbang sogs chab srid kyi khe dbang btsan 'phrog byas/68

nga tsho dgon nas phud pa dang / lhag bsam rgyal mtshan khro sems gnon ma thub pa/ snyo9rang nyid khyim du 'dzul skabs nang mi rnams hang sangs nas mig chu 'don bzhin ring ba'i skra dang gyon pa'i skya chas la khong tshos mthong mi 'dod pa byed kyang kyi/ gcig gi gcig la sku zhabs slebs song zhes 'bod res byas te rim bzhin pha ma dang / gcen gcung tshos lus la 'thams shing dga' skyo zung gi mig chu gtong bzhin/ phyogs gcig nas zas kyi sne len byas/ khong tshos ha cang tshor ba rno ba'i skyo gdung byed pa mthong skabs ngas khong tshor bzos pa'isdug bsngal chung ngu gtan nas min par shes te/ ci shod 'di shod med par nga'i sems nang lo 'ga'i sngon gyi skyo snang gi lo rgyus shig lham mer dran/phran lo bcu gnyis skabs pha karma dge legs rgyu lhag gi na tshas mnar te sman bcos ha cang dka' bas/ 'chi rgyur thag chod nas cha rkyen zhan pa'i rdzong sman khang gi nyal khrir lus skabs/ lha sar na tsha de bcos thub slor thos rjes a ma bde skyid sgrol mas thabs shes du mas lha sa sgo bsten sman khang gi em chi zhig rdzong sman khang du skad btang ste/ gshag bcos byas nas gang mtshams drag skyed byung skabs khog pa'i nang em chi'i lag cha lus te rnag brgyab pas yang bskyar gshag bcos byed dgos byung /69

70 lbing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/gshag bcos thengs gnyis kyi dus rgyun nas 'tsho bcud zhan pa'i pha'i lus zungs ha cang nyam zhan du gyur te khyim du mal sar lus/mu ge'i thog la zla lhag ces pa ltar skabs der tag tag lha sa'i slob grwar yod pa'i nga'i gcen po'i rkang par nad byung zhing sman khang du lus nas rkang pa gcod dgos la thug ste/ a mas pa phar lta sna ga byed dgos pa dang mar lha sar 'gro dgos pa/ khyim du rgan 'go phran dang bu phrug bzhi'i 'tsho gos skyong dgos pa bcas dka' ngal tshad med 'phrad de/ lo der zhing kha yang 'debs ma thub par lus skabs thag ring gi gnyen las grong pa'i dgra legs/ zhes pa'i dpe ltar grong pa khyim mtshes rnams kyis zhing ba6ba pa dang / sgo phyug rnams kyang khong tshos 'tsho skyong dang bzhos te mar nga tshor sprod kyi yod/gong du bshad pa ltar/ ngas dran tshod la da lta'i sdug bsngal gyi ngu skad de nga tsho'i khyim tshang nang grags pa thengs gnyis pa red/ 'on kyang sngon gyi mig chu dang mi 'dra bar da lta'i nga tsho'i mig chur gzi brjid cung yod pa/ grong pa khyim mtshes rnams kyis kyang shes te sang nyin de nas bzung gcig rjes gnyis mthud ja dang / sha/ sgo nga sogs 'khur nas 'byor zhing / khyed tshos bod bstan srid kyi ched de ltar byas par mtha' gcig tu rgyab skyor sku da/ nga chodas 1959 nas 70

nga tsho dazhon nas phud pa dang / lhag bsam rgyal mtshan khro sems gnon ma thub pa/ 71bzung rgya dmag dang 'thab rgol gyi las 'gul ji snyed cig spel myong yang / da cha lo na rgas/ 'on kyang rang rigs dang rang rgyal la bcangs pa'i chod sems la 'gyur ba med/ da dung yang sems shugs skyed nas bod don las 'gul spel dgos pa'i bslab bya gnang mkhan yang nyung nyung gtan nas min/71

brgyad pa/zhing khul dwa bsdad pa dang ma 'ongs pa'ityā bsams gzhigs /phyi nyin 6wags pa gnam gshis dwangs shing bsil snga da snyom pa dang /rta bdun dbang po'i 'od zer sa gzhi chen por 'phros shing / zhing kha'i lo tog rnams bsil rlung zhig gis mgo lcog ldem ldem du bsgyur zhing /bya byi'u khyu dang khyu rang rang ci dgar nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phur bskyod byed pa bcas/ zhing khul gyi mdzes ljongs de 'dra zhig yod pa de bar tshor snang ma byung / sems nang gi bde tshor cung zad cig las nyams su ma tshudang gong gi chu tshod dgu pa'i mtshams/ shang srid gzhung gi las byed bod mi rdo rjes gus pa shang du yong dgos pa'i brda bskyal/ pha dang nga gnyis thon khar a mas sems khral chen pos skad cha brtan po shod dgos pa'i bslab bya brgyab byung /72

zhing khul du bsda pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i bsams gzhigs/ 73shang du nga tsho btson nas blo da pa'i mi gsum dang / dgon nas phyir 'bud byas pa'i mi bzhi bcas dang / rang so so'i pha ma tshogs pa'i dbus 'go khrid kyis de ring khyod tsho 'bod dgos don ni/ gzhung nas gal che'i gsal bsgrags shig 'byor gsal spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i slob gso/ dang / 7gong sa mchog la rgyab gtod/ mes rgyal la dga' zhen byed dgos pa sogs kyi phru ba gso du ma zhig khrid/der nga tsho btson zur gsum gyis de ring gi slob gso de btson khang nas cha tshang slob sbyong byas pas/ 'dir bskyar du nyan 'dod dang /khas len yang zhu 'dod med ces bshad de ma nyan par tshogs ra nas phyir thon pas shang gi las byed pa byed thabs ci yang med par de nyin gyi tshogs 'du 'thor gzhig phyin/ pha ma tsho 'jigs snang dang sems 'tshab chen po langs/ dus yun cung nas shang gi las byed gcig gis gus khang pa'i nang 'bod de/ btson nang gi gnas tshul rnams dris byung / phran gyis btson par rdung rdeg btang ba dang khrag btsags pa rnams re re bzhin zol med drang por brjod pas/ khong gis dngos gnas red dam/ zhes dris/ ngas de dag ra 'phrod dang bcas bshad pas khong gis rgya gzhung la mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur shugs cher gnang ste/ nga tsho bod mi rigs kyi bde skyid kyi slad btson du 'tshud pa dang /73

74 lbing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/tshe las 'das pa de tsho dngos gnas byas rjes chen po zhig red/ nga la cha mdzargan na/ shang gi las byed yin stabs gzhung gi gtan 'bebs bkag rgya ma bshad rang bshad red/ ces dbugs ring zhig btang ste mu mthud nas/ khyed tshos mi rigs kyi bden don ched phebs pa de ni ha cang gi gzi brjid dang / slo stobs red/ ngas bod kyi bu phrug rnams skyon med 'tshar longs yong ba'i re ba byed kyi yod kyang / bu phrug rnams bod nge na chab srid las 'gul nang zhugs te 'chi rmas ci byung yang nga la blo 'gyod gtan nas med/nga tshos khyed tsho 'di gar skad gtong skabs phebs rogs/ zhib phra gang zag so so'i sems nang yod pa de rang red/ phar tshur phebs skabs shang nas chog mchan blangs na dge mtshan yod red/ ces bshad/log khar shang gi 'go khrid kyis nga chorware lag tu yig cha re sprad de bdun gcig ring pha ma dang mnyam tshogs 'dur yong dgos zer/ rang nyid btson nang rdung rdeg gis gzugs gce nga can bzos yod pas bdun gcig gi tshogs 'dur dbo ngas pa sprad phro gas bshad kyang / ma sprad pas thengs gsum tsam tshogs 'dur bskyod/tshogs 'dur nga tsho mi bdun dang / dgon pa nas gsar du phud pa/ rang khul gyi thon pa bcas dang nang mi khyon mi nyer gnyis 'dug74

zhing khul du bsda pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i bsams gzhigs/ 75nyin gsum pa'i slob sbyong gi bar gseng la dgon nas phyir 'bud byas pa'i mi nyer gnyis lam zur gyi spang steng bsdad nas blo bzang mkhas grub kyis chu mngar shel dam re re dang / zas rigs nyos te mnyam zas la rol zhing sdod mus su sku zhabs blo bzang dge 'dun gyis bshad don/ nye lam rgya gzhung chos don las khungs 'go khrid kyis 'o/ bco brgyad ma son pa'i grwa pa rnams dbye ste/ ske la kha btags a shel re g.yogs shing lag tu chu mngar shel dam re sprad de khyed tsho da lta rang lo chung bas so so'i yul gyi slob grwar 'gro dgos/ zhes bshad de phyir 'bud byas pa dang / de dang dus mtshungs chab srid kyi dogs gzhis phud pa dang / de sngon tshags par thog dga' ldan dgon pa'i grwa mang gis 7gong sa mchog gi sku par rang 'gul gyis bsdu ba sku/gas/ rgyal gces pa yin tshul rdzun gtam spel bar spyi tshogs thog don dngos gsal rtogs sku nga thabs ched/ rang 'tshams kyi thon pa 150 bcas bsdoms na grwa pa 300 dgon pa'i skyid sdug dang kha 'phral 'dugadon dngos dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa gcig gis kyang sku par phab pa ngos len ma byas rkyen rgya gzhung las byed kyis/ lha khang gi lje mig 'phrog ste kho pa tshos sku par tshang ma phabs pa sogs dge 'dun spyi byings rnams gnas bzod mi bde ba chen po bzos sku da tshul sogs 75

7snyo lhing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/bshad byung / nyin der nga tsho dgon nas phud pa'i tshogs 'du der gyen langs byed mkhan 'phan sngo/ ba lhag bsam rgyal mtshan dang 'phan po ba spen pa/ stag rtse thar rgyas tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bcas dang po rgu tshar bcug pa dang de nas btson chad lo gsum re bzos te khri zam du bcug pa shes byung /zla ba de'i tshes 9 nyin tshogs 'dur 'gro dgos rung / gter kha sngog yul du 'gro dgos snyam ste gzugs gzhi gcongs can yin tshul bshad nas pa lags la dgongs pa zhu bar mngags pa bzhin dgongs pa sprad/ tshes 10 zhogs pa bo gas ngo nor bu dang / zla ba bcas mnyam me shing 'thu bar yin tshul ri la bskyod de/ chu tshod bzhi tsam nas gter kha sngog yul tha lung nang ngam zhabs kung nang zer ba'i ri 'dabs su slebs skabs/ sngar nags tshal gyis khengs pa'i ri de da cha thal ba tshom bur spungs yod pa dang / rgo ba dang sha ba/ gla ba/ phyi ba/ lha bya gong mo dang / sreg pa/ bya ngang sogs bsad pa'i rus pa dang spu sgro'i phung po chags 'dug nga rang chung dus tha lung nang thengs mang bskyod myong ba dang / ri rtse rdza ri dang ri sked spa ma dang glang ma/skyer pa/ ba lu/ tsha ru sogs shing nags kyis khyab cing / der 'dus pa'i 'dab bya sna tshogs dang / ri dwags gla ba dang / rgo ba/ rna ba/76

zhing khul du bsda pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i bsams gzhigs/ 77sha ba/ 'phyi ba sogs grangs kyis mi lang bas khyab yod/ da cha byi'u'i skad tsam thos rgyu mi 'dug nga tshos gter kha 'don sa'i nye 'gram me shing 'thu ba dang de nas 'phrul 'khor la ya mtshan che mdog gis lta skabs dmag mis de tsam pa'i do snang mi byed/dmag 'khrug chen po zhig langs pa ltar ri'i g.yas g.yon dang 'dabs rol bcas kyi gting sngog pa/ ri sked la lam gtod pa/brag rdo dang dgun kha sa 'khyags la rdzas me grangs med nyin mtshan lta sa med brgyab pas/ sngar dben pa'i khor yug der ci 'gar 'ahrū ba'i 'dab chags dang ri dwags gnas rgyu phar zad/ de khul gyi 'brog pa rnams kyi nor lug kyang 'tsho sdod dka' ba'i gnas su lhung / gter sngog yul nas chu tshod gsum gyi bar khyad yod pa'i rgya ma mda'i ko sgang du dug chu 'dres pa'i chu rdzing chen po zhig bzos nas der/ nyin ltar rlangs 'khor gyis gter rnams dbor nas dwangs snyig dbye ste gter dngos rnams skam dang / do po brgyab ste rgya nag tu dbor/ gter kha sngog mkhan las mir rab 'bring tha gsum gyi go rim bzos shing /sngog 'don byed mkhan ga༄ḍa bo rgya dmag gcig pu yin pas gang zhig sngog gi yod min shes mkhan med/ gter kha sngog yul gyi mtha' bzhir deng dus kyi go mtshon thogs pa'i dmag mis bskor yod/77

78 lhing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/spyi lo 1980 lor rgya ma dang / yar 'brog mcho gnyis kyi gter kha de sngog rgyu'i las 'go brtsams rung / sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi rnam sprul 7kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med rnam gnyis kyis bkag sdom 'og lo shas bya thabs med par lus/ rang cag bod 'bangs yongs kyi bsod nams kyi nyi ma snum zad kyi mar me bzhin zad de/ 7kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs rjes rgya gzhung gis bod zhen/ ldan pa'i mi snar gnon 'tsher dang / mkhas dbang khag la gnon shugs/ bod kyi rtsa che'i rig dngos rku 'phrog lhag par rgya ma dang / yar 'brog mtsho gnyis kyi gter kha sngog rgyu'i las 'char 'go btsugs te/ gter rnams rgya nag tu dbor 'dren byas dang byed bzhin pa tshang mas shes shing / phangs sems kyis mig 'bur ljir yang smra ma thub par dgun gyi khu byug bzhin mi bzhugs ka med 'di red/gter kha thengs dang po sngog skabs rgya ma mi mang yongs kyis ngo rgol skad 'bod dang / 'khrug 'dzings shugs cher byas rkyen/ rgya gzhung gis rgya mar glog gi mthun rkyen 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu yin tshul mi mang la mgo skor btang zhing / mgo skor gtong ched shar rlung rtags can gyi rlangs 'khor che chung gnyis rgya ma shang la sprad cing / gter 78

zhing khul du bsda pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i bsams gzhigs/ 79kha sngog pa'i khe bab rgya ma shang dang cha bgos byas te lung pa yar rgyas gtong rgyu/ gter sngog las ka rgya ma'i mi mang rnams la sprad de yong bab yong ba bya rgyu bcas/ don tshan 'ga' gros chod lta bu bzhag kyang /rlangs 'aspo/ ra gcig rdzong gi nyar te shang la rag med pa dang gter sngog yul du lam bzo skabs/ las ka rgya ma'i yul mir sprad kyang rjes su sngog yul dngos kyi las ka yul mir sprod rgyu phar zad/ shang gi 'go khrid kyang las yul du bcar thabs bral ba red/nyin gsum tsam nas lha sar bod sman zhig bsten pa dang mar lam gter kha bzhu sbyang byed pa'i mtsho der blta bar 'gro dgos snyam mur/ stabs legs pa zhig la lha sa nas mched grogs ngag dbang khri ral gyis sman bcos su yong dgos pa'i brda 'byor byung bas/ pha ma gnyis la 'grel bshad byed bde byung / shang la dgongs zhu bskyar du ma byas par sngon gyi dgongs shog gis mthus par byas te tshes 14nyin gyi snga dro khyim nas thon te/ mar lam ko khang sgang du yod pa'i bzo grwa chen po dang dug chu'i rdzing yod sar blta bar bskyod pas/ bzo grwa de'i las ka byed mkhan tshang ma rgya rigs sha stag yin pa dang dug chu'i rdzing de'i 'khris su bcar du mi bcug pas gnas tshul dngos shes thabs bral yang / dug chu'i rdzing de shor tshe/ des gar khyab kyi skye 7()

zur bkol/ 115pa de'i tshe nags shod kyi skye bo tshos 'phya zhing ban de glen pa tshos lam bgrod kyi dka' ngal shin tu che bas shing de rnams ga la 'drong zer/'on kyang bla ma'i thugs skyed byin rlabs kyis cha rgyus med pa'i lam phreng shin tu tsub pa rnams las grol te nyin bzhi'i thog 'bri gung thang la thon/de nas rim gyis snon rgya mar 'byor te zla ba phyed dang gsum la nags shod nas 'khor/ shing de rnams shing bzo byed pa na ldeng ba'i skabs dang bral te/ slar yang 'i/nga 'dren pa'i yo byad kyi grabs gshom la zhugs/ dpon rgan dar ma rdo rje dang / lha bzo phag snas thog drangs te/ ar skya sum cu tsam gyi mdzo rta bzhi bcu/ 'phral la dgos pa'i nor rdzas bur ltang dang / tshos ltang sogs cha rkyen ci dgos rdog nas nags shod gsum pa'i yul du phyin kyang shing 'dren pa'i re ba bral nas slar yang phyir 'byor/ sngar las lhag pa'i gra sgrig gi shugs gcig sgril gyis nags shod phyogs su bskyod de gnas sngo brtson shākya la sogs par re ba bcol nas mdzo pho brgyad cu dang / rte dre'u mang po la dgos pa'i nor rdzas ji snyed bkal te ded nas bskyod/ de mi grangs brgya lhag thab tsho bcu bzhi byas te nags shod la bskyod/ ka rong shing sar thams cad zas nor gyis tshims par byas na/sa stod du shing 'dren du bcug5

)16 lhing 'jasas med pa'i tshe stod/smad du 'bru rigs nas la sogs pa cha rkyen sgrub kyang / dpon ma bzhugs pa na mi rnams las ma byas par bzhag slar yang dpon gyis spro ba bsrings te shing 'dren rnams la bur ltang bzhi lnga tsam brngan par byin nas/ pho mo thams cad kyi lung pa bkang nas shing rnams nyi ma lnga yi sa stod phur la khar bskyal/ shing chen rnams smri ti la kha brgyud si ri rong la shing rnams bsags nas chur btang ste rgya ma snon gyi mdar 'dren par byas pa'i dka' ngal brgya phrag gi khrod nas legs par thar ba'i mtshan snyan gyi ba dan rgya ma sgang gi nam mkhar khyab par byas nas dpon dar ma rdo rjer dga' bsu tshad med mdzad do/ de nas lcam shing chung ba'i gras rnams dwags po'i smad nas drangs te mal gro'i phu nas chu la drangs nas rgya ma snon mdar spab pa dang / de ltar dpon rgan dar ma rdo rjes nags shod la lan dgu dang dwags gro'i yul du lan dgu bcas bskyod de ka gdung lcam shing gi dka' ngal rnams sel bar gyur to/ 'gro dgon rin po che thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur nas gtsug lag khang gong ma gsar du rmang gding ba'i dus la bab/ rgya ma khri khang gi lcags ri chen po de gtsug lag khang ma brtsigs gong nas yod par gda'/ stag gi lo dpyid dus gza' spen pa sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum sgyu rengs stag gi dus la gtsug lag khang gsar ma'i rmang gzhi /16

zur bkol/ 117btings/ slob dpon bzang mo bas kyang mthun rkyen bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrubs par mdzad cing / de ltar gtsug lag khang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rten dang brten par bcas pa blo yul du mi shong ba zhig bskrun par mdzad pa'i dkar chag rnams yi ge mang du dogs nas mdor bsdus te gtsug lag khang gsar rnying gong 'og gnyis ka rgya khyon 'dra ba tsam zhig yod 'dug mdzad pa mtha' dag mthar phyin nas spyi lo 1210 bod rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags rta lo smad mgo zla ba'i tshes 4srod la sku gshegs/ sku gdung zhugs la phul nas da lta'i mchod rten nyams gso zhus pa de gdung rten yin zhes grags/ slob dpon ston pa nas dbu drangs te lho ba ma rim brgyud du byung ba yin no/rmad byung mtshan dpe'i lang tsho brgyan pa'i sku// rmad byung mdo sngags gzhung lugs thogs med gsung // rmad byung yon tan bang mdzod 'dzin pa'i thugs// rmad byung sangs rgyas skal ldan shing ltar grags//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//gsum pa/ rin chen sgang sangs rgyas khu dbon gyi rnam thar mdzad pa po spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ spyi lo 1402 bod rab byung bdun pa'i chu rta lor/ yul lhas lung chos gra gra dgon gyi zhol/ gra rnam khang zhes pa'i yab dgyer dbon po chos skyabs dang / yum jo mo bla ma 'bum /17

118 lhing 'jags/ med pa'i tshe stod/la sras lcam sring lnga byung ba'i nang gi bla ma 'di'i mtshan la nam mkha' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang sngo zhu/ rin po che kun dga' blo gros kyi drung du/ rgya ma rin chen sgang gi gzim khang dkar gro'i rtser dgung lo bdun la rab tu byung nas mtshan la blo bo sa rgyal mtshan gasku la/ skam dgon gyi gdan sar phebs/ gra dgon mkhan chen bsod nams shes rab dang / skyor lung mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang / slob dpon sher bzang pa sogs la bsten/ dgung lo bcu bdun la gtsang phyogs su byon te/ dben gnas ri bo mdangs can du mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi zhabs la gtugs te sras kyi mthu snga ra gyur/ der chos rje blo gros pa yi zhabs la'ang gtugs/ dgung so/ bco brgyad la zhwa lu dang gnas rnying rnams su gra skor mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu la sbad nya dbon pos dbus su gdan drangs/ dgung lo nyi shu la rtsed thang du chen po blo 'phel bas grogs mdzad nas/ bshad sar dang gra bskor mdzad/ de rjes tshogs chen du mkhan po yon tan rin chen pa dang / las slob dang gsang ston slob dpon nor bzang pa la sogs rnam par dag/ pa'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas mal gro spang sa se ba rong du rje btsun 'jam dpal rgya mtsho bzhugs par lan gnyis tsam byon yang sku mtshams su bzhugs pas ma mjal/ gzim khang la bskor dang phyag 'tshal/ gsol ba btab nas 8

zur bkol/ 1 )9'ol /khar byon/ 'jam dpal rgya mtshos se ba blo'ing nas gsung shog gnang ste/ khyed nged kyi bla ma spyan snga dpal ba'i dbon po yin 'dug pa cis kyang byon dgos gsungs nas slar yang mjal du byon/ sku'i drung nas sba bsri med pa'i chodas gnang ba rnams legs par gsan/ bla ma la yang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis lung bstan zhig byung yod par snang /bdag gis kyang kho thag chod pa'i thos pa byas pa dang / zer tshad la kha phyi 'brang ma byas pa ni mdun ma legs pa'i tshad du gyur ces gsung / de nas 'ol khar phyir phebs te rdzing phyi mkhan po rje btsun bzang po skyong ba'i drung nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/ codil kha rdzong dpon rgya mchos bas kyang bkur bsdi phun sum tshogs par mdzad/ phyis skam dgon gyi gdan sa ma mdzad par nam mkha'i rgyal po bskos/ de nas bzung rgya ma rin chen sgang dang zangs lung phu rgyab sogs la sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad/jo bo rje gshegs khar tshe blos thongs gsung ba zhig byung / nyams len gyi snying po ni/ 'du 'dzin spong ba dang / thos pa gsog pa/ nor mi 'tshol ba/ ja chang btsan dug ltar spong ba/ 'dod yon la 'khri ba gcod pa/ 'gro ba kun la bu gcig pa ltar brtse bar mdzad pa de dag yin zhes gsungs/ bla ma bcu phrag gnyis la nye bar bsten par mdzad pa ni/ rje tsong pa dang rgyal tshab rje/ mkhas grub rje/ dga' ldan gyi khri thog bzhi 1/9

1na0 wīng 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/pa chos rje blo gros pa/ 'dul 'dzin pa/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ bzang skyong ba/ chos bzang pa/ dgyer kun dga' blo gros/ gzhon 'od pa/bsod nams bzang po sogs legs par bsten cing / skam dgon du gdan drangs kyang ma byon/ rjes su nam mkha'i rgyal 1/ sku gshegs nas byon dgos byung / skabs der rgya ma rin chen sgang yang dgon pa mi nyams gong 'phel du gnas shing / rje mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang yang rin chen sgang du bla ma 'dis gdan drangs te lam rim gyi bka' chos kyang nyin mang po bar gsungs/ sku che'i mthar skam dgon du sku zhi bar gshegs/sku gshegs dus spyi lo 1472 bod rab byung brgyad pa'i chu 'brug yin/dgung grangs bdun bcu tsam bzhugs/ bla ma 'di'i rnam thar blo gros 'jigs med rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i mdor bsdus shig las ma rnyed/ 'di ni rang nyid kyi bla ma rgya ma rin chen sgang gi gdan sa pa yin par nges so/blo gros rab tu byung ba'i bla ma zhig blo gros rin chen sgang gi rtse nas byungo //bla gras gzhan las khyad par 'phag/sa pa na'ang // bla gras gzhan pa thams cad skyong bar mdzad//120

zur bkol/ 121ces bya ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//bzhi pa/ snon rgya ma'i yul gyi byung ba ngo sprod gsal tsam 'ig zhu dgos par snang yang khungs ldan min par dgos med kyi tshig rnyog mang po zhig bris kyang klog pa sngo tsho yang nyob 'gro ba'i rgyur 'gro dogs nas mdor bsdus tsam 'chad pa la/ mal gro gung dkar rdzong khuo/ ngas rgya ma shang ni/ lha sa nas spyi le bdun cu tsam gyi shar ngos la yod/ yul de ni chos rgyal gnam ri srong btsan dang / 'bri bzang thod dkar gnyis kyi sras khri srong btsan nam srong btsan sgam sngo zhes yongs su grags pa thang rgyal rabs kyi btsun mo 'un shing kong jo btsun mor bsus te rgya bod kyi 'brel ba thog mar btsugs pa dang / bod ljongs su chab srid phyogs brgyar bskyed de chos srid kyi go 'phang yangs por phye bar mdzad pa'i chos rgyal de'i 'khrungs yul du grags shing / de yang gnam ri srong btsan mal gro'i yul la chab srid kyi mdzad pa'i lo rgyus tun hong gi yig rnying du mang po gsal ba ma zad/ yum yang 'bri bza' yin pa sa bab 'brel mtshungs kyi don la gnas pa zhig yin pa the tshom med/rjes su chos rgyal gong ma tshos pho brang yar klung 'phyongs rgyas sosar su yod pa de tsho 'en gnas mdzad pa dang / rang nyid kyi pho brang bsti gnas gsar pa skyid shod ra sa'i ljongs su 'pho bar mdzad pa sogs lo rgyus 12/

122 zhing 'jags med pa'i tshe stod/zhib pa gzhan la yongs su grags pas brjod par mi bya/ da lta'i yul gyi nub ri'i ngos su chos rgyal 'khrungs khang gi shul tsam ngos 'dzin rgyu yod cing / der phreng 'go chu mig zer ba zhig yod pa de nas chos rgyal sku 'khrungs ma thag tu rdo sku rin po che 'khrungs zhes pha bong kha'i gnas yig tu gsal por 'khod yod pa chu mig de da lta yang yod/ de bzhin rgya ma lung pa'i mda'i shar ngos su ri zur steng rgyal wa'i sku mkhar zhes pa'i lha khang yod pa de'i nang srong btsan gyi 'jim sku mi tshad ldab tsam byas pa zhig sku da kyang lo bcu'i zang zing nang lha khang dang bcas pa gtor zin/ 'on kyang da lta'i yul gyi dad ldan mang tshags kyis lha khang dang sku brnyan gsar bzhengs mdzad yod/ spyir snon rgya ma'i yul ni dbus ri bar bskor du grags pa'i nags tshal ri bo grags can mang po yod pa'i nang gi ri bo maṇaḍal zhes pa'i 'dabs su chags yod pa dang // yul de'i rtswa chu shing gsum 'dzoms shing gcan gzan ri dwags bya rigs sna tshogs rtsi shing me tog gi khrod du nyams dga' bar brtsen pa'i gnas yin par ma zad/ skye bo 'o/ mo rnams kyang chodas sems che zhing las la khyod ba/ zhing 'brog thon skyed bzang wa'i dpal gyis phyug pa zhig sku/da/ sa skya 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku dus su bod khri skor bcu gsum btsugs skabs dbus stod rgya ma khri khang 'di khri skor /22

zur bkol/ 123bcu gsum gyi ya gyal yin pa yig rnying sku/ rgyus nang sku ngas su grags shing / rgya ma khri khang zhes pa'i ming de yang de'i dus su chags pa red/gzhan yang rgya ma rin chen sgang gi srung ma zangs lham mo'i gasku/la mchodad du/ rgya ma sgang gi bka' srung gnyan po'i tshogs//gnas bzhi dgon brgyad btsan lnga mthu rtsal can// zhes 'kho da pa ltar gnas bzhi dang dbo na brgyad yod/ gnas bzhi ni/ 1) rgya ma shar tha lung nang gi phur g.yu khung brag ces pa slob dpon padma'i skrub khang brag phug rgya cher 'gro sa yod pa ngo mtshar can dang / 2) de'i 'og gsham du rgyal ba klong chen rabs 'byams kyi sgrub khang lcog lha zhes pa zhig yod/ der da lta dam can rdo rje legs pa dang / g.yu sgron ma'i lha rten brag 'bur du thon pa che chung gnyis gshib tu sku da/ 3) yul gyi gzhung lho ngos rin chen sgang gi mdun spyi bo ri'i nub rgyud bzang lung ri khrod ces pa sngar spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan la sku gas pa skye thod dam pa mang po bzhugs myong ba/ 4) rin chen sgang gi lho'i lung pa'i phur phu rgyab ri khrod ces pa dpal mgon zhal bzhi'i gnas spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / rjes su paṇa chen chod bzang chos rgyan la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa mang pos sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas dben cing nyams dga' ba sku da/ de dag phu rgyab gnas yig dkar chag tu'ang gsal/ dasku/na brgyad ni/ spyi lo 1090/23

124 lbing 'ardzags med pa'i tshe stod/nang sku 'khrungs pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dgyer sgom pas phyag btab pa'i rgya ma rin chen sgang nang sgrub gsar dang / sgrub rnying zhes pa'i dgon pa'i shul khag gnyis gsum yod cing / rgya ma khri khang lcags ri'i nang dgyer sgom gyi thugs sras 'gro mgon sangs rgyas dbon gyis phyag btab pa'i mchod khang gong 'og gsar rnying gi shul rnams yod/ sngar mchod khang rnying nga/ 'og ma'i nang rten gtso rgya gar shar li rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal sku tshad thog rtseg gcig lhag tsam yod pa byin can bdud rtsi phebs myong ba dang / mchod khang gong gsar ma'i nang 'bo/ mgon sangs rgyas dbon gyi 'dra sku mi tshad che tshad tsam rgya gar shar li byin can bdud rtsi dngos su 'bebs pa sogs bzhugs yod kyang rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gtor te gzhan rnams bzhugs med/ bcu gcig zhal gyi sku smad sngar gyi li ma de rjes su lag son byung med/ sku stod 'jim las gsar bzhengs zhus pa da lta yang mjal rgyu yod/ da dung sangs rgyas dbon bla slob kyi gdung 'en sku 'bum gsum yod pa zhib tshad byed skabs zhabs nas dbu'i gañdzidzara'i tog bar thog rtseg drug bdun tsam yod pa dbus kyi de nyams gso byas shing de 'phros rnams gtor shul tsam bsdad yod/ dum bu ri zhes pa'i dgon shul rgya che ba gong sa lnga pa'i skabs ma gtor bar bsdad 124

zur b.lol/ 125yod pa bai ser nang du gsal yod/ ri steng mchod rten mang po yod pa bcas da lta shul tsam dang / ri steng gi mchod rten kha shas dad ldan mang tshogs tshos nyams gasku byas 'dug lung pa mda'i stag shug ri 'dabs su dgon shul yod/ g.ya' ma ri bo yer ba'i shar ngos ri ldabs su dpa' la'i sgang zhes pa'i dgon shul yang yod/ rgya ma'i phu thugs lcags zhes pa'i khyim tshang gi thad du a ṇi'i dbo na pa sogs kyi shul yod pa sku gas dgon pa brgyad las mi nyung ba shul mthong rgyu yod/ rje tsong kha pa'i sku dus tsam na snon rgya ma khri khang dang / rin chen sgang sku gas kyi dgon pa rnams ma 'thor bar bsdad yod pa spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gsung las kyang gsal por rtogs shing / der ma zad lnga pa'i sku dus tsam na'ang dbo na par ming btags chog pa tsam bsdad yod pa bee ser sogs las kyang rtogs thub/ yul gyi kha rgyun du sog po 'jon gar bas gtor lugs shig shod srol 'dug par gzhigs na/ rgyal po lha bzang skabs yul 'di'i dgon pa dang sde dpon rnams lha bzang gi phyogs ris su gtogs te 'jon gar ba'i sber rdung zhig phog ste lha khang dgon pa rnams gtor ba min nam snyam pa zhig 'dug pa las lo rgyus kyi yig cha khungs ldan zhig lag sku/na mig/ lam du gsal ba zhig ma byung / rgyal po lha bzang gi rjes su rgya ma khri khang ni hor khang gsar gyi sger gzhis su bdag pa dang / rin chen 125
